text: Handling deadlines is an important skill in both study and work. Good time management helps you plan tasks and avoid last-minute stress. Prioritization means deciding which tasks are most urgent and doing them first. Scope management is also useful: if a project is too big, you may need to reduce it or focus on the most important parts. Finally, communication matters. If you realize you cannot finish on time, tell your teacher, manager, or team early. They may offer help or more time. By managing your time, priorities, and workload, and by speaking up, you can meet deadlines more successfully.
